exposure: Fetal Pillow method during full-dilatation cesarean delivery
Hand-push method during full-dilatation cesarean delivery
outcome: Duration of stay in hospital following delivery
Admission to neonatal intensive care unit
cohort: The study included women who underwent full-dilatation cesarean deliveries at term, utilizing either the Fetal Pillow or the hand-push method.
finding: The Fetal Pillow group exhibited lower mean intra-operative blood loss, a shorter duration of postpartum hospital admission, and higher mean cord arterial pH compared to the hand-push method group.
mod_finding: The Fetal Pillow method during full-dilatation cesarean deliveries was associated with improved maternal and neonatal outcomes compared to the hand-push method.
